home__subtitle: Pulsed power · Industrial comms · HMI design
home__description: Master's student at the Institute of Electrical Engineering, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences. My research focuses on high-voltage pulsed power supplies, and I specialize in industrial communication and front-end HMI design. Find me as 科苑沐泽 across all platforms.
about__description: Web developer, with extensive knowledge and years of experience, working in web technologies and Ui / Ux design, delivering quality work.
about_slide1__text: Creator of the WeChat account “Tech Self-Media”, with 10k+ followers across platforms and a Tencent creator recognition. My guide “Origin Plotting Skills Every Grad Student Needs” has earned 100k+ likes.
about_slide2__text: Winner of the Huawei Developer Competition Atom Service Contribution Award. I work across front-end and embedded software design — a seasoned student developer.
about_slide3__text: My projects include a Qt serial-port host application, an online Modbus debugging site, VIT-CNN font recognition, and a virtual CAN driver.
